Also enforced by .husky/pre-commit. Attempts 1 and 2 used script shell C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe and exited 1 with 'Docker daemon is not running'. The daemon was in fact up ('docker info' reported Server Version 23.0.6). Git's bin/bash.exe is a login-shell wrapper that moves ~/bin ahead of the Rancher Desktop path that was put first on PATH, so the script's 'where docker' found the ~/bin/docker shim instead of docker.exe. Attempt 3 used the non-login script shell C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/bash.exe, so Rancher's docker.exe stayed first. Gitleaks then ran: 'scanned ~119024750 bytes (119.02 MB) in 3m19s' / 'no leaks found'. Scans the working tree only, not git history. No npmrc was changed.
